issues.legal_issue: Whether a pre-settlement land grant subject to favourable rent and personal services to a zamindar was included in the assets of the zamindari at the permanent settlement.
material_facts: The land was granted before the permanent settlement in return for favourable rent and personal services to the zamindar.
Documents showed that the zamindar granted remissions when the services were not required and that the services were personal to the zamindar.
The Government had not claimed a right to resume the land before or after the permanent settlement.
The evidence did not rebut the presumption that the land had not been excluded from the zamindari assets.
issues.conclusion: The land was part of the zamindari estate and was covered by the government notification under the Estates Abolition Act.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 4 of Regulation XXV of 1802, lands exempt from public revenue or paying only favourable quit rents were presumptively excluded from zamindari assets. A grant subject to personal services to the zamindar, or to favourable rent together with such services, was presumptively not excluded because the services, alone or alongside the rent, were treated as equivalent to full assessment. The Court relied on Mahaboob Sarafarajawant Sri Raja Parthasarathy Appa Rao Bahadur Zamindari Garu v. The Secretary of State (1913) I.L.R. 38 Mad. 620 and Secretary of State v. Rajah Vasireddy, A.I.R. 1929 Mad. 676. Section 3(b) of the Madras Estates (Abolition and Conversion into Ryotwari) Act provided for an estate, including its tanks, to vest in the Government, but applied only if the land formed part of an estate.

rule.if: estate_classification_dispute and pre_settlement_land_grant and favourable_rent_paid and personal_service_to_zamindar and presumption_not_rebutted

predicates.estate_classification_dispute: The proceeding concerned whether land formed part of a zamindari estate at the permanent settlement.
predicates.pre_settlement_land_grant: The land had been granted before the permanent settlement.
predicates.favourable_rent_paid: The grantee paid rent at a favourable rate for the land.
predicates.personal_service_to_zamindar: The grantee was required to perform personal services for the zamindar as a condition of the grant.
predicates.presumption_not_rebutted: The evidence did not rebut the presumption arising from the grant's rent and service conditions that the land had not been excluded from the zamindari assets.

issues.definition: When a dispute concerns the estate status of pre-settlement land granted for favourable rent and personal services to a zamindar, and the resulting presumption of inclusion is not rebutted, the land is treated as part of the estate.
